question: Which will have the bigger price change by close of August 3: Ethereum or Bitcoin?

model.prompt_context: This market resolves based on which asset has the larger absolute percentage price change on Aug 3, 2026 (UTC), calculated using CoinGecko historical daily closing prices. For each asset, compute the percentage change between the CoinGecko closing price for Aug 2, 2026 and the closing price for Aug 3, 2026. The asset with the larger change in absolute terms (ignoring direction, i.e. |% change|) wins. Canonical source: CoinGecko price history pages for Ethereum (coingecko.com/en/coins/ethereum/historical_data) and Bitcoin (coingecko.com/en/coins/bitcoin/historical_data). If both absolute changes are identical to two decimal places, resolve as 'Tie'.
